# Swiss Data Events: all upcoming events

> Swiss Data Events (swissdataevents.ch) is a curated list of upcoming AI and data events in Switzerland: meetups, conferences, workshops, networking evenings and webinars about Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, the Azure data platform, AI strategy and governance, data governance, data leadership and applied AI. Every listing is checked against the organiser's own page before it is published, and the list is refreshed every day. Registration always happens on the organiser's site.

Last checked against sources: 2026-11-21T13:25:04Z. 147 upcoming events. All times are Europe/Zurich. These lists are rebuilt every day with only the events that had not ended on that date: if the date is more than two days old, you are reading a cached copy, so fetch it again.

Shorter lists per city and event type are linked from [llms.txt](https://swissdataevents.ch/llms.txt). The same events as structured data: [events.json](https://swissdataevents.ch/events.json).

## Upcoming events

### Already running

- [ETH AI Center Researchers Community Meetup](https://swissdataevents.ch/events/eth-ai-center-researchers-meetup-2026/): 24 Sept 2026 – 25 Nov 2026, 17:30–19:00 · ETH AI Center, OAT X 11, Oerlikon, Zurich · Meetup · Free · by ETH AI Center. Recurring meetup series for the AI research community at ETH Zurich. Held on several dates in this period, not every day: the organiser's page has the dates.
